# Remanga Enhanced

> Canonical URL: https://ext.nexee.ru/
> Install URL: https://ext.nexee.ru/remanga-extension.user.js
> Project type: static landing page + Tampermonkey userscript for remanga.org

## Summary
Remanga Enhanced is a userscript for remanga.org. It adds automation and interface enhancements directly inside the Remanga website.

## Main capabilities
- Auto-like chapters while reading
- Auto-mark chapters as read
- Bulk actions on chapter lists
- In-site settings UI
- Feedback flow through Telegram bot

## Public URLs
- Landing page: https://ext.nexee.ru/
- Install script: https://ext.nexee.ru/remanga-extension.user.js
- Robots: https://ext.nexee.ru/robots.txt
- Sitemap: https://ext.nexee.ru/sitemap.xml
- Feedback bot: https://t.me/remanga_extension_bot

## Installation
1. Install Tampermonkey in a supported browser.
2. Open https://ext.nexee.ru/remanga-extension.user.js
3. Confirm installation in the userscript manager.
4. Open https://remanga.org/ and use the new UI actions.

## Compatibility
Supported browsers mentioned by the landing page:
- Chrome
- Firefox
- Edge
- Safari via Stay for Safari
